messages:
incident-bot: Pager notification - P0: Generation 5xx spike (us-west-1)
• Impact: elevated 5xx on /v1/generate for a subset of requests (~15% observed in alert window)
• Trigger: error-rate alert firing across gen cluster in us-west-1
• Pager: @maria (oncall-sre)
• Runbook: begin triage, gather logs, draft status update, notify customers if impact sustained

maria: Ack. Investigating now — pulling LB metrics and service logs. Will start a thread for statuspage copy.

henry-sre: On it with you, looking at model-serving nodes and KV cache metrics. Attaching recent tail of error log in a sec. :eyes:

ajay: For incident comms: need an initial statuspage blurb, a clear customer impact line, and cadence for updates (15m). Who can draft?

maria: Drafting initial status page copy below. Will hand off publishing to @sam-product once legal/product ok.
```
DRAFT status page update (initial)
Summary: We are investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting generation requests in the us-west-1 region.
Impact: Some customers may experience failed generation responses or delayed responses.
Scope: Approximately 15% of generation requests routed through us-west-1 are returning 5xx errors.
Mitigation: Engineering is actively investigating and evaluating temporary routing options and service restarts.
Next update: within 15 minutes.
```

sam-product: LGTM as a starting point. Suggest soften any absolute language. Will wait for legal review before publishing. :+1:

legal: Please avoid asserting root cause or claiming fallbacks unless verified. Recommend changing 'routing options' to 'temporary routing options are being evaluated' and keep 'investigating' language.

elaine-support: Add a customer-facing impact line and support link. Example: 'If you see failed generations, retrying may succeed. If you need immediate assistance, open a ticket at https://support.redwood.ai.'

ajay: Suggested edit below; I'm making it explicit about affected region and next update cadence.

maria: Updated draft with legal/support tweaks — posting final DRAFT for approval.
```
STATUS PAGE - INITIAL UPDATE (DRAFT)
Summary: We are investigating elevated 5xx errors impacting generation requests in the us-west-1 region.
Impact: Some customers may experience failed generation responses or delayed responses. Retrying requests may succeed.
Scope: Approximately 15% of generation requests routed through us-west-1 are affected.
Mitigation: Engineering is actively investigating; temporary routing options are being evaluated.
Support: If you need immediate assistance, open a ticket at https://support.redwood.ai.
Next update: within 15 minutes.
```

sam-product: Approved from product. I'll publish the initial status update now and add it to the incident timeline. Posting link after publish.
sam-product: Published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1719999999 (internal link, draft -> live) :white_check_mark:

maria: 15m update: still investigating. We scaled the serving pool and applied a hotfix to the autoscaler; error rate decreased from ~15% to ~6% in the last 5 minutes. No confirmed root cause yet. Next update in 20 minutes or earlier if status changes.
ajay: Preparing customer-facing email for affected accounts. Will share copy for review.
henry-sre: Initial root-cause signal: KV cache thrash correlated with a recent model rollout job. Rolling back the rollout on a subset of hosts now to validate.
maria: Rolling back rollout on 3 hosts. Monitoring error rate and latency closely.
sam-product: Published update 2 to status page with the mitigation and reduced error rate note. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1719999999/updates/2

incident-bot: Incident resolved — generation 5xx spike in us-west-1 has returned to baseline.
• Resolved at: 1720006119 (UTC)
• Summary: Error rates returned to normal after rollback of a recent rollout and autoscaler adjustments.
• Next steps: postmortem assigned to @henry-sre, target publish within 72 hours.
• Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1719999999 (final update includes resolved notice)

maria: Closing on-call notes and creating brief for postmortem. Thanks everyone for fast responses. :heart:
